population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days

endpoint.span: The primary outcome, recurrent symptomatic, objectively confirmed VTE and related deaths during 6 months of treatment

estimate.span: occurred in 30 of the 1279 dabigatran patients (2.3%) compared with 28 of the 1289 warfarin patients (2.2%; hazard ratio, 1.08; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.64-1.80;

analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS): consisted of all randomised patients who were documented to have taken at least one dose of study drug. Patients were assigned to the treatment groups as randomised, i.e. regardless of the actual medication taken.

treatment_strategy.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days, we compared dabigatran 150 mg twice daily with warfarin.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome, recurrent symptomatic, objectively confirmed VTE and related deaths during 6 months of treatment

served_mismatch: The served HR and CI match the six-month primary endpoint, but the intention-to-treat label is inaccurate: the registry specifies an FAS restricted to randomised patients taking at least one dose, analysed as randomised. The estimate applies to six months of treatment, not the longer post-treatment observation period.

candidate_rejections.why: Reject this candidate's attribution to an unrestricted intention-to-treat population; retain the numerical estimate with the registry-supported FAS and six-month treatment timepoint.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Registry entry criteria specify adults with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or PE; the analysis-set restriction is addressed separately.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion criteria: * Acute symptomatic uni- or bilateral Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or Pulmonary Embolism (PE) * Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

notes: Registry spans support the analysis set and adult symptomatic entry criteria. Six months is the stated acute-treatment duration. The registry separately reports HR 1.13 (95% CI 0.69 to 1.85) through the end of the post-treatment period, planned up to day 224; this is a different observation window.
